title: Youthful Yellow Greek Smoked Turkey Neck Stew
description: A hearty and romantic Greek stew featuring smoked turkey neck, this dish is perfect for a cold winter night, with a funky and chewy texture that will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the smoked turkey neck to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, chicken broth, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the lemon juice mixture over the turkey neck and onion mixture in the skillet.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Transfer the mixture to individual mini cocottes and cover with lids.
Bake the stew in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the meat is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
